headline: Malu Paper Mills reports September quarter financial results
summary: Malu Paper Mills Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance figures for the second quarter of the fiscal year. These reported numbers are now a matter of public record for shareholders and market participants. Retail investors tracking micro-cap paper stocks can review the filing for revenue and profit trends.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for review
